name: HitLayer
description:
The pointer and keyboard surface over a plot. It writes the position to the hover store;
the marks never re-render. It is one tab stop exposed as a slider over the data positions
(R11.5: arrows move within it), so a keyboard or screen-reader user gets the same readout
as the pointer, and Escape clears it.
signature: ({ store, count, locate, anchor, snap, nav, onActivate, onEscape, label, valueText, initial, cursor, bounds, onKey, keyShortcuts }: HitLayerProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: anchor
props.description: Position index → plot-local px where the readout anchors (the snapped point).

props.name: bounds
props.type: { left: number; top: number; width: number; height: number; } | undefined
props.description: Cover only part of the plot (plot-local px), leaving the rest (a legend) to the pointer.

props.name: count
props.description: How many positions the cursor can visit.

props.name: keyShortcuts
props.description: The extra keys, for assistive tech (`aria-keyshortcuts`): "+ - Shift+ArrowLeft".

props.name: locate
props.description: Plot-local px → position index (null: nothing there).

props.name: nav
props.type: ((index: number, key: string) => number | null) | undefined
props.description: Arrow-key movement; default steps through indices in order. Return null to stay.

props.name: onActivate
props.description: Click or Enter on a position (drill-down, selection).

props.name: onEscape
props.description: Escape or Backspace: back up a level (drill-downs). Without it Escape clears the cursor.

props.name: onKey
props.description:
Keys the chart handles itself (a zoomable chart's + and −), before the cursor keys. It
receives the event and the cursor's index; return true when it handled the key.

props.name: snap
props.description: Pointer readouts follow the snapped x (line charts) instead of the pointer itself.

props.name: store
props.description: External store observed by the component.

props.name: valueText
props.description: What the cursor is on, for assistive tech: "10:32 · CPU 34%".
